_comment: Hand-written content for the docs build. 'descriptions': what each token visibly changes (Markdown inline code allowed). 'screenshots': per token group (key = section code like 1b), [file in docs/screenshots, caption].

descriptions.$palette-primary: Main brand colour. Becomes `$ui-primary` (primary buttons, "Actions" menus, "Hide details" toggles, pagination, progress bars, carousel dots, active tab underline, brand fills), seeds the generated primary shades (2a) and tints the default home banner gradient.
descriptions.$palette-secondary: Links and text actions (`$ui-link`): text links such as KB article titles, "Copy Permalink" and "Post a comment", faceted search, condition-builder AND groups. Seeds the link hover shade.
descriptions.$palette-accent: Selected / active state (`$ui-selected`): active tab label, active pills, chosen dropdown and list items, toggles, select2 highlight. Second glow in the default banner gradient.
descriptions.$palette-focus: Keyboard focus ring on inputs, buttons, links and Next Experience components (`$ui-focus`). Needs at least 3:1 contrast with white.
descriptions.$palette-white: Card, panel, input, menu and modal surfaces; text and icons on coloured fills; default header background.
descriptions.$palette-neutral-5: Page background and subtle fills: table stripes, hover rows, panel headers, disabled inputs.
descriptions.$palette-neutral-10: Stronger fills: progress track, code background, active/hover table rows, skeleton loaders.
descriptions.$palette-neutral-20: Dividers and the borders of cards, panels, tables, dropdowns and modals (`$ui-border-subtle`). Default label background.
descriptions.$palette-neutral-30: Light grey (`$color-light`) and the matching Next Experience neutral step.
descriptions.$palette-neutral-40: Secondary borders (`$ui-border`): pagination hover, like/reply buttons, tab hover underline. Empty KB rating stars.
descriptions.$palette-neutral-50: Disabled controls and icons (Next Experience disabled states, KB attachment controls).
descriptions.$palette-neutral-60: Form input borders and the secondary button border (`$ui-border-strong`). Needs at least 3:1 contrast with white.
descriptions.$palette-neutral-70: Badge background, Bootstrap `$gray-light`, secondary button hover border.
descriptions.$palette-neutral-80: Mid-dark grey for Next Experience components and AI Search tertiary text.
descriptions.$palette-neutral-85: Muted text (`$ui-text-muted`): hints, placeholders, field labels, timestamps, breadcrumbs, editor toolbar icons.
descriptions.$palette-neutral-90: Secondary text (`$ui-text-secondary`): supporting text, legends, 'last updated' meta lines.
descriptions.$palette-neutral-100: Body text (`$ui-text`) and the text on status fills (`$ui-status-text`).
descriptions.$palette-black: Modal backdrop and Bootstrap `$gray-base`; replaces the literal blacks in core CSS.
descriptions.$palette-success: Success status: icons, alert borders, `.btn-success`, timeline success badge.
descriptions.$palette-success-light: Success alert, label and banner fill.
descriptions.$palette-warning: Warning status: icons, alert borders, 'due today'.
descriptions.$palette-warning-light: Warning alert/label fill, journal 'note' comments, search-term highlight.
descriptions.$palette-danger: Danger status: required-field asterisks, error text and borders, `.btn-danger`, overdue dates.
descriptions.$palette-info: Info status: icons, alert borders, info messages.
descriptions.$palette-primary-dark: Hover / pressed state of everything primary (`$ui-primary-hover`).
descriptions.$palette-primary-darkest: Deepest brand shade (Bootstrap `$brand-primary-darkest`, Next Experience brand colour).
descriptions.$palette-primary-light: Light brand tint (`$brand-primary-lighter`, Next Experience interactive tint).
descriptions.$palette-primary-lightest: Light brand fill (`$ui-primary-subtle`): menu hover, chips, select2 hover, editor button hover.
descriptions.$palette-primary-pale: Faintest brand tint: primary label background, search result highlights, bottom of the default banner gradient.
descriptions.$palette-accent-light: Light selection tint (Next Experience selection scale).
descriptions.$palette-accent-lightest: Selected row background in data tables (`$ui-selected-subtle`).
descriptions.$palette-success-dark: Dark success shade (alert text/icon contrast in Next Experience).
descriptions.$ui-primary: Primary brand role: Bootstrap `$brand-primary`, primary buttons (via `$ui-button-primary-bg`), pagination, progress bars, carousel indicators, tab underline, catalog/list accents, Next Experience primary scale.
descriptions.$ui-primary-hover: Hover / pressed state of primary elements, editor primary button hover, 'clear all' links.
descriptions.$ui-primary-subtle: Light brand fill: menu item hover, chips, select2 option hover, editor button hover.
descriptions.$ui-on-primary: Text and icons on a primary background (buttons, active pagination, primary panels).
descriptions.$ui-link: Text links, text buttons, pagination numbers, faceted search, condition-builder AND.
descriptions.$ui-selected: Active tab, selected list/dropdown item, active pill, toggles, select2 highlight.
descriptions.$ui-focus: Focus ring on inputs and controls (Bootstrap `$input-border-focus`, header search, KB search, select2, editor, Next Experience focus).
descriptions.$ui-text: Body text everywhere: Bootstrap text, inputs, dropdown items, labels, header nav, breadcrumbs (active), search, catalog, tickets.
descriptions.$ui-text-secondary: Supporting text: legends, 'last updated' lines, catalog field help.
descriptions.$ui-text-muted: Hints, placeholders, field labels, timestamps, disabled links, editor toolbar icons, header secondary text.
descriptions.$ui-text-inverse: Text on dark or coloured fills: success/danger buttons, badges, `<kbd>`, catalog error pills.
descriptions.$ui-heading-color: Colour of h1-h6 and widget titles. `inherit` = same as body text; set a colour for coloured headings.
descriptions.$ui-page-bg: Background behind everything (body, wells, breadcrumbs bar).
descriptions.$ui-surface: Cards, panels, inputs, dropdowns, popovers, modals, editor, secondary buttons.
descriptions.$ui-surface-subtle: Table stripes, hover rows, panel headers/footers, disabled inputs, input add-ons, comment backgrounds.
descriptions.$ui-surface-strong: Progress track, code background, active table row, default buttons in lists, skeleton loaders.
descriptions.$ui-border-strong: Form input borders, input add-on borders, secondary button border, search boxes.
descriptions.$ui-border: Secondary borders: pagination hover, tab hover, like/reply buttons, catalog quantity controls.
descriptions.$ui-border-subtle: Cards, panels, tables, dividers, dropdowns, modals, timelines, comments, editor chrome.
descriptions.$ui-success: Success colour (`$brand-success`): buttons, alert borders, timeline badge, positive Next Experience alerts.
descriptions.$ui-warning-bg: Warning alert/label fill, 'note' journal entries, search highlight (via `$ui-highlight-bg`).
descriptions.$ui-danger: Danger colour: required asterisks, error text/borders, `.btn-danger`, catalog validation.
descriptions.$ui-info: Info colour: alert borders, info messages, AI Search info.
descriptions.$ui-status-text: Text on all status fills (alerts, form-state messages).
descriptions.$ui-rating-star: Filled rating / favourite stars (KB articles, attachments).
descriptions.$ui-highlight-bg: Search-term highlight in results (`<mark>` and the search widgets).
descriptions.$ui-filter-or: Colour of 'OR' groups in the condition builder.
descriptions.$ui-header-bg: Header (navbar) background. Footer and second menu row follow it unless set separately.
descriptions.$ui-header-text: Header links, menu labels, user name, search icon. Hover/active/disabled shades are derived from it.
descriptions.$ui-header-hover-bg: Header menu item hover background (derived: 5% text over bg, works on dark headers).
descriptions.$ui-header-active-bg: Header menu item active/open background (10% text over bg).
descriptions.$ui-header-disabled-text: Disabled header items (20% text over bg).
descriptions.$ui-header-border: Line under the header (same as bg = no line).
descriptions.$ui-subnav-bg: Second header row (the menu bar) and its dropdown menus. Same as the header by default; set it with `$ui-subnav-text` for a light logo bar over a coloured menu bar.
descriptions.$ui-subnav-text: Menu bar text, carets and dropdown items when the menu bar has its own colour. `null` = header text (one-colour header).
descriptions.$ui-subnav-hover-bg: Hovered and open menu bar items and hovered dropdown items. Derived from `$ui-subnav-bg`; only used when `$ui-subnav-text` is set.
descriptions.$ui-logo-max-height: Maximum logo height in the header.
descriptions.$ui-footer-bg: Footer background (defaults to the header background, like OOTB).
descriptions.$ui-footer-divider: Line above the footer's bottom bar.
descriptions.$ui-hero-text: Home banner and KB banner heading/subtitle colour. `null` = use the Portal Banner widget's colour options.
descriptions.$ui-hero-bg: Home banner and KB banner background (any CSS background: colour, gradient, `url()`). `null` = use the widget's Background Image option.
descriptions.$ui-button-primary-bg: Primary button background and border (incl. login button and editor primary button). Override to give CTAs a colour different from the brand primary.
descriptions.$ui-font-family: Font for everything: body, Bootstrap, Coral includes, `--now-font-family` and (after Sync) Next Experience components. The font must also be loaded, see Fonts.
descriptions.$ui-font-size-base: Base text size; every Bootstrap font size (h1-h6, small, large) is computed from it.
descriptions.$ui-heading-transform: Letter case of page and widget titles (h1/h2), e.g. `uppercase`. `null` = as written. The hero sub-heading and Next Experience components keep their own case.
descriptions.$ui-heading-letter-spacing: Tracking for the same titles, e.g. `.04em` with uppercase. `null` = normal.
descriptions.$ui-radius-sm: Small radius: small inputs, tags, Next Experience small radius.
descriptions.$ui-radius: Default radius: inputs, dropdowns, pills, ticket/approval/catalog/KB elements, Next Experience medium radius.
descriptions.$ui-radius-md: Medium radius: ticket header cards, item panels, menus.
descriptions.$ui-radius-lg: Large radius: cards, panels, modals, comment bubbles.
descriptions.$ui-radius-button: Button radius (also login, Next Experience buttons). 999px = pill buttons.
descriptions.$ui-radius-card: Panels/cards: KB tiles, ticket panels, catalog item panels, list widgets, datepicker.
descriptions.$ui-radius-search: Home banner, header and KB search boxes.
descriptions.$ui-space-xs: 4px step: small control padding, label margin, condensed table cells.
descriptions.$ui-space-sm: 8px step: table cells, large control vertical padding, nav links, breadcrumbs.
descriptions.$ui-space-lg: 16px step: button horizontal padding, form-group spacing, alerts, modals.
descriptions.$ui-space-xl: 24px step: panel body/heading padding, large buttons.

1b: `$palette-primary: #E6007E` - primary/secondary buttons, carousel dots, banner tint
`$palette-primary: #E6007E` on a case - Actions, Send, Hide details, active tab underline
2f: Same overrides on a ticket page: square cards, pill buttons
